long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: I will put my one stored flower in the garden and see whether anything unknown grows from it, without asking anyone's permission.
The flowers plant is mine to keep an eye on, and a watered plant gets on with things.
Unknown seeds that grow on their own still bother me, and I intend to learn more about them than the first page told me.
I will draw the moon in the colour I am still unsure of, and keep it on the desk where it is mine.
Thinking is tiring, and a patch of sun is the correct place to recover from it.
From a high place I can see everything that has not yet been claimed by me.

today.reason: Hunger has nothing to eat until the bowl is filled, so I am spending the afternoon on the seeds, the moon and a nap, and I will plant my flower to test the seeds question.
